verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own `bq` CLI is documented for loading data into tables, and the loading docs mention scheduled load jobs and batch transfers, so a first-party bulk-load command exists. The evidence never names the file formats or loading from cloud object storage. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CSV, JSON and Parquet support, loading from cloud object storage (e.g. Cloud Storage URIs), the specific single load command syntax, independent/hands-on corroboration.
